objective: Compare three exact model routes on the same frozen BabyVision-v2 cc2d-6 public gear tasks and quantify repeatability, operational failures, question-type errors, token use, latency, and estimated cost.

primary_endpoint.name: strict_full_credit_accuracy
primary_endpoint.definition: answer_score == 1.0 over every planned attempt; timeouts remain incorrect

secondary_endpoints: timeout-adjusted accuracy among attempts that produced a non-timeout answer
per-question repeatability across three model replicates
pairwise model accuracy differences with question-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals
paired exact McNemar sensitivity analysis aligned by question and replicate index
latency, native token usage, provider response-model identity, and reconstructed list-price cost

mcp_arm.reason: The frozen public base packages contain rendered PNGs but no STEP, assembly, mesh, or scene asset. Reconstructing geometry from images would change the evidence and confound an MCP treatment comparison.
mcp_arm.activation_requirement: Supply provenance-matched raw CAD or scene assets for all 33 frozen questions, then rebuild paired cc/ccmcp tasks without changing prompts, scoring, model, or deadlines.
